title: Chemistry in Externally FUV-irradiated Disks in the Outskirts of the Orion Nebula Cluster
question: Does the chemistry of protoplanetary disks externally irradiated by FUV fields in the ONC outskirts differ from that of isolated disks?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.2 and 1.3 mm settings, 220 and 265 GHz); archival Band 7
data.angular_resolution: ~0.13 arcsec high-res continuum (~54 au); ~0.5 arcsec lines

what.value: Stellar and disk properties (mass, inclination, PA, v_LSR, disk mass) for 216-0939

evidence.quote: The stellar and disk properties were taken from (cite: factor_alma_2017) and (cite: williams_alma_2014)

external_data.citation: Factor et al. 2017; Williams et al. 2014

what.value: Literature isolated-disk line fluxes for comparison sample

evidence.loc: Comparison between irradiated and isolated disks

external_data.citation: Huang 2017; Bergner 2019a,b, 2020; Pegues 2020, 2021, 2023; Law 2021; Guzmán 2021; Öberg 2021

evidence.quote: based on Herschel FIR observations (cite: Pabst2021)
Molecular data extracted from the CDMS

recipe.method: Self-cal on pseudo-continuum, then tclean continuum at robust +0.5 with elliptical masks
uvcontsub then tclean with robust +0.5, uvtaper 0.5 arcsec, Keplerian masks, 0.4 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Measure continuum disk sizes and radial profiles
recipe.method: Deprojected radial profiles; size = radius containing 95% of flux
>=3 sigma in >=3 channels within Keplerian mask; matched filter in visibilities using HCN and C18O as filters
Multiply cubes by Keplerian mask (immath) and sum; uncertainty from 1000 bootstrap samples of shifted centers plus 10% calibration in quadrature; 3 sigma upper limits

assumptions: LTE and optically thin; Tex 20-50 K

recipe.method: Ratio of HCN 3-2 (smoothed to Band 7 beam) to HCN 4-3, optically thin
Distance-normalized fluxes and flux ratios vs stellar mass with Spearman correlations against literature sample

a central cavity with an outer edge at $120-135$ au
a disk size of $239.1\pm14.5$ au and $108.7\pm14.5$ au for 253–1536A and 253–1536B
a disk size of $239.1\pm14.5$ au and $108.7\pm14.5$ au for 253–1536A and 253–1536B
